3119-what-is-your-culture-to-me.creator: Charles Dudley Warner
3119-what-is-your-culture-to-me.description: A book by Charles Dudley Warner. ideal; although the young graduate is not long in learning that there is an indifference in the public mind with regard to the first aorist that amounts nearly to apathy, and that millions of his fellow-creatures will probably live and die without the consolations of the second aorist.

arxiv-1702-06264.title: Weighted Motion Averaging for the Registration of Multi-View Range Scans
arxiv-1702-06264.creator: Rui Guo 1, Jihua Zhu 1∗, Yaochen Li 1, Dapeng Chen 1, Zhongyu Li 2, Yongqin Zhang 3
arxiv-1702-06264.description: Abstract Multi-view registration is a fundamental but challenging task in 3D reconstruction and robot vision. Although the original motion averaging algorithm has been introduced as an effective means to solve the multi-view registration problem, it does not consider the reliability and accuracy of each relative motion. Accordingly, this paper proposes a novel motion averaging algorithm for multi-view registration.

arxiv-2101-12027.title: A transformer based approach for fighting COVID-19 fake news
arxiv-2101-12027.creator: S.M. Sadiq-Ur-Rahman Shifath, Mohammad Faiyaz Khan, Md. Saiful Islam
arxiv-2101-12027.description: Abstract The rapid outbreak of COVID-19 has caused humanity to come to a stand-still and brought with it a plethora of other problems. COVID-19 is the first pandemic in history when humanity is the most technologically advanced and relies heavily on social media platforms for connectivity and other benefits.

arxiv-2309-09933.title: Improving the convergence of an iterative algorithm for solving arbitrary linear equation systems using classical or quantum binary optimization.
arxiv-2309-09933.creator: Erick R. Castro, Eldues O. Martins, Roberto S. Sarthour, Alexandre M. Souza, Ivan S. Oliveira
arxiv-2309-09933.description: Abstract Recent advancements in quantum computing and quantum-inspired algorithms have sparked renewed interest in binary optimization. These hardware and software innovations promise to revolutionize solution times for complex problems. In this work, we propose a novel method for solving linear systems. Our approach leverages binary optimization, making it particularly well-suited for problems with large condition numbers.

arxiv-2309-12872.title: Deep regression learning with optimal loss function
arxiv-2309-12872.creator: Xuancheng Wang*, Ling Zhou, Huazhen Lin
arxiv-2309-12872.description: Abstract Due to powerful function fitting ability and effective training algorithms of neural networks, in this paper, we develop a novel efficient and robust nonparametric regression estimator under a framework of feedforward neural network (FNN). There are several interesting characteristics for the proposed estimator.

arxiv-2310-08468.title: Machine Learning Assisted Cognitive Construction of a Shallow Depth Dynamic Ansatz for Noisy Quantum Hardware
arxiv-2310-08468.creator: Sonaldeep Halder, Anish Dey, Chinmay Shrikhande, Rahul Maitra
arxiv-2310-08468.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sonaldeep Halder, Anish Dey, Chinmay Shrikhande, Rahul Maitra. The development of various dynamic ansatz-constructing techniques has ushered in a new era, rendering the practical exploitation of Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) hardware for molecular simulations increasingly viable. However, they exhibit substantial measurement costs during their execution. This work involves the development of a novel protocol that capitalizes on regenerative machine learning methodologies and many-body perturbation theoretic measures to construct a highly expressive and shallow ansatz within the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) framework.

arxiv-2401-00829.title: A Simple Construction of Tournaments with Finite and Uncountable Dichromatic Number
arxiv-2401-00829.creator: Arpan Sadhukhan
arxiv-2401-00829.description: Abstract The dichromatic number χ ⁡ ( G → ) \chi(\vec{G}) of a digraph G → \vec{G} is the minimum number of colors needed to color the vertices V ⁡ ( G → ) V(\vec{G}) in such a way that no monochromatic directed cycle is obtained.

arxiv-2403-10963.title: Pointer-Generator Networks for Low-Resource Machine Translation: Don’t Copy That!
arxiv-2403-10963.creator: Niyati Bafna, Philipp Koehn, David Yarowsky
arxiv-2403-10963.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Niyati Bafna, Philipp Koehn, David Yarowsky. While Transformer-based neural machine translation (NMT) is very effective in high-resource settings, many languages lack the necessary large parallel corpora to benefit from it. In the context of low-resource (LR) MT between two closely-related languages, a natural intuition is to seek benefits from structural “shortcuts”, such as copying subwords from the source to the target, given that such language pairs often share a considerable number of identical words, cognates, and borrowings.

arxiv-2511-12741.creator: Aritro Pathak
arxiv-2511-12741.description: Abstract We introduce a technique, to obtain pointwise upper and lower bounds for the Green’s function of elliptic operators whose principal part is the Laplacian and that include a drift term diverging near the boundary like a power of the inverse distance with exponent less than 1 1 , in the unit ball B ⁡ ( 0 , 1 )

arxiv-2602-23892.title: Towards Tsallis Fully Probabilistic Design
arxiv-2602-23892.creator: Vyacheslav Kungurtsev, Giovanni Russo
arxiv-2602-23892.description: Abstract In this paper we present the foundations of Fully Probabilistic Design for the case when the Kullback–Leibler divergence is replaced by the Tsallis divergence. Because the standard chain rule is replaced by subadditivity, immediate backwards recursion is not available.

pmc-10648439.title: Genome-Wide Characterization and Haplotypic Variation Analysis of the YUC Gene Family in Foxtail Millet (Setaria italica)
pmc-10648439.creator: Qiang Meng, Renliang Zhang, Yannan Wang, Hui Zhi, Sha Tang, Guanqing Jia, Xianmin Diao, Alvaro Galli
pmc-10648439.description: Panicle development and grain production in crop species are essential breeding characteristics affected by the synthesis of auxin, which is influenced by flavin monooxygenase-encoding genes such as YUC (YUCCA) family members. In this trial, fourteen YUCs were identified and named uniformly in foxtail millet, an ancient crop species cultivated across the world.

pmc-10672470.title: Endocarditis after Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement
pmc-10672470.creator: Lorenzo Braghieri, Simrat Kaur, Christopher K Black, Paul C Cremer, Shinya Unai, Samir R Kapadia, Amgad Mentias, Bernward Lauer, Francesco Pelliccia, Laurent Fauchier
pmc-10672470.description: Transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) use is gaining momentum as the mainstay for the treatment of aortic stenosis compared to surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR). Unfortunately, TAVR-related infective endocarditis (TAVR-IE) is expected to be detected more and more as a result of the ever-expanding indications in younger patients.

pmc-10674564.title: Cardiac Abnormalities in a Predictive Mouse Model of Chagas Disease
pmc-10674564.creator: Amanda Fortes Francisco, Giovane R. Sousa, Mhairi Vaughan, Harry Langston, Archie Khan, Shiromani Jayawardhana, Martin C. Taylor, Michael D. Lewis, John M. Kelly
pmc-10674564.description: Chronic Chagas cardiomyopathy (CCC) results from infection with the protozoan parasite Trypanosoma cruzi and is a prevalent cause of heart disease in endemic countries. We previously found that cardiac fibrosis can vary widely in C3H/HeN mice chronically infected with T. cruzi JR strain, mirroring the spectrum of heart disease in humans.

pmc-10748560.title: Lateralizing Calcaneal Osteotomy Performed with a Percutaneous Burr Results in a Significantly Lower Increase in Tarsal Tunnel Pressure
pmc-10748560.creator: Ali A. Siddiqui, Wesley Troyer, Jugert Bango, Glenn Shi, Jeannie Buckner, Rita DiTommaso, Edward T. Haupt
pmc-10748560.description: Category:Hindfoot; Basic Sciences/BiologicsIntroduction/Purpose:Single-plane calcaneal osteotomies are used to manage hindfoot deformity. Neurological complications, such as tarsal tunnel syndrome, are well-documented following lateralizing calcaneal osteotomy. Traditionally, calcaneal osteotomy is performed using an oscillating saw. No studies have investigated the effect of alternative surgical techniques on postoperative tarsal tunnel pressure.

pmc-11356038.title: Enhancing Flexible Neural Probe Performance via Platinum Deposition: Impedance Stability under Various Conditions and In Vivo Neural Signal Monitoring
pmc-11356038.creator: Daerl Park, Hyeonyeong Jeong, Jungsik Choi, Juyeon Han, Honglin Piao, Jaehyun Kim, Seonghoon Park, Mingu Song, Dowoo Kim, Jaesuk Sung, Eunji Cheong, Heonjin Choi, Joseph Pancrazio, Philipp Gutruf
pmc-11356038.description: Monitoring neural activity in the central nervous system often utilizes silicon-based microelectromechanical system (MEMS) probes. Despite their effectiveness in monitoring, these probes have a fragility issue, limiting their application across various fields. This study introduces flexible printed circuit board (FPCB) neural probes characterized by robust mechanical and electrical properties.

pmc-11430974.title: Current Advances and Challenges in the Management of Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma in Immunosuppressed Patients
pmc-11430974.creator: Sophie Li, Thomas Townes, Shorook Na’ara, Adam C Berger, Gerardo Ferrara
pmc-11430974.description: Simple SummaryCutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) is a common and potentially dangerous skin cancer, especially for people with weakened immune systems, like those who have had organ transplants or certain blood cancers. These individuals are up to 100 times more likely to develop cSCC compared with the general population.

pmc-11541061.title: Significant Pathologic Response Following Neoadjuvant Therapy and Curative Resection in Patients With Rectal Cancer: Surgical and Oncological Outcomes From a Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-11541061.creator: Fatemeh Shahabi, Majid Ansari, Khadijeh Najafi Ghobadi, Abolfazl Ghahramani, Amiresmaeil Parandeh, Maryam Saberi‐Karimian, Ala Orafaie, Abbas Abdollahi
pmc-11541061.description: AimThis study evaluated surgical complication rates, recurrence‐free survival, overall survival (OS), and stoma status of patients with rectal cancer after significant pathologic response following neoadjuvant treatment and curative resection. Pathologic complete response (pCR) and near‐pCR patients constitute patients in our study.

pmc-12645328.title: Estimated costs and benefits of participation in an extreme ritual in Mauritius
pmc-12645328.creator: Eva Kundtová Klocová, Radek Kundt, Pushkar Varma Puryag, Martin Lang
pmc-12645328.description: Humans often participate in physically harmful and demanding rituals with no apparent material benefits. Although such behaviours have traditionally been explained using the lens of costly signalling theory, we question whether the canonical theory can be applied to the case of human cooperative signals and introduce a modification of this theory based on differential benefit estimation.

pmc-12678878.title: Neurocardiology - from basics to clinic
pmc-12678878.creator: Ze-Xin Fan, Na Liang, Jian-Feng Lu, Guang-Zhi Liu
pmc-12678878.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Neurocardiology is an interdisciplinary field that studies the interactions between the nervous and cardiovascular systems, encompassing research across the entire spectrum, from molecular mechanisms to clinical diagnosis and treatment. The disease types in neurocardiology include several major categories: Involvement of the nervous and cardiovascular systems caused by common factors, involvement of the cardiovascular system caused by neuropsychiatric abnormalities, and involvement of the nervous system caused by cardiovascular abnormalities. Routine and special examinations are needed during the diagnostic process.

pmc-12788070.title: Nano-Elicitation Approaches for Boosting Secondary Metabolites in Medicinal Plant Cell Cultures
pmc-12788070.creator: Pooran Golkar, Edgar Vázquez-Núñez, José R. Peralta-Videa
pmc-12788070.description: Medicinal plants are a rich source of diverse secondary metabolites (SMs) with significant industrial and medicinal applications. However, the natural content of these compounds is often low and influenced by various environmental and biological factors, making large-scale extraction from conventionally cultivated plants challenging.

pmc-13251221.title: Barriers and facilitators while implementing community first responder systems in a western setting: mixed-methods expert consensus
pmc-13251221.creator: E. Moens, E. Degraeuwe, M. L. Caputo, R. Cresta, R. Greif, E. Baldi, T. Barry, B. W. Böttiger, J. Bray, H. J. Busch, S. Cheskes, C. D. Deakin, A. A. Doshi, M. M. Ekkel, D. Elschenbroich, D. Fredman, L. Gamberini, J. Ganter, F. L. Henriksen, C. J. Jagtenberg, M. Jonsson, M. Khalemsky, T. Marks, B. Me
pmc-13251221.description: BackgroundEarly cardiopulmonary resuscitation and timely defibrillation are key determinants of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest survival. Community first responder (CFR) networks improve early response, yet adoption varies internationally. This study summarizes current key factors affecting CFR-system implementation through an international expert consensus process.MethodsA mixed-methods design explored barriers and facilitators to CFR system development.

uslaw-usc-t7-s2224.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 55 (Department Of Agriculture). Employees of the Division of Accounts and Disbursements may be detailed by the Secretary of Agriculture for accounting and disbursing work in any of the bureaus and offices of the department for duty in or out of the city of Washington, and employees of the bureaus.
